data.body: Linux re-measurement (server image rebar-mcp-uv0136:test, same store snapshot as the 2026-10-28 runs, 9 next_batch calls on threads): new code par9 peak 717 MB (after 116 MB), seq9 peak 114 MB; old code par9 peak 4,967 MB. The burst now sits about 3 GiB under the 3.63 GiB container limit, so no concurrency queue is added (operator decision: queue only if the slim pass still approached the limit). Timings not comparable: host under LM Studio load and make verify.
